evidence.decision_reason: The official FC Online Open API currently documents account, match, ranker, metadata, and image API groups, but no market-wide price-history API. Do not use this source as the Gate 0A price-history source.

The official Data Center UI exposes 7/30/90/180/365-day market-price windows. The current NEXON integrated service terms apply to service use but do not explicitly authorize automated extraction, so this PoC limits the source to manual browser capture. Native granularity and the raw response evidence hash still need to be measured from one saved PlayerPriceGraph response.
